basic.namaAplikasi: Integrated Monitoring and Evaluation Information System

heroSection.deskripsi: Quality assurance and internal supervision are essential pillars in implementing the university's vision and mission toward a dignified and high-quality higher education institution.

kalenderAkademik.deskripsi: The academic calendar serves as an integrated information source that provides a reliable reference for all important academic dates and deadlines, enabling academics to effectively plan their activities throughout the semester.
kalenderAkademik.belumTersedia: Academic calendar is not available yet.
kalenderAkademik.kalenderUniversitas: Muhammadiyah University of Cirebon Academic Calendar

selamatDatang.deskripsi: You have successfully accessed the dashboard. From here, you can access various modules, monitor data, and manage activities according to your role in the system.

monev.deskripsi: The Monev module provides an integrated platform to monitor and evaluate the implementation of academic and institutional activities, helping users analyze performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support data-driven decision-making.

ami.deskripsi: The Internal Quality Audit (AMI) module supports structured and documented internal audit processes to assess compliance with quality standards, identify improvement areas, and strengthen a culture of continuous quality enhancement.

manajemenModul.deskripsi: The Module Management module facilitates structured system module management, including adding, updating, and configuring modules, ensuring optimal system integration and operation.

manajemenPeriode.deskripsi: The Period Management module supports planned academic period management, including schedule setting and time range configuration, ensuring academic activities run in an orderly and coordinated manner.

manajemenPengguna.deskripsi: The User Management module provides centralized tools for managing user accounts, roles, and access permissions, helping administrators maintain system security, organization, and operational efficiency.

manajemenUser.deskripsi: The User Management module provides a centralized means to manage user accounts, roles, and access permissions, helping administrators maintain system security, order, and efficiency.

placeholder.cari: Search users by name, email, or role...

nonaktif.deskripsi: Deactivating a user will restrict their access to the system and prevent them from performing any actions. This action is typically taken when a user leaves the organization or no longer requires access.

manajemenRole.deskripsi: The Role Management module facilitates role administration within the system, including creating, updating, and configuring access permissions to ensure an effective role structure that aligns with organizational needs.

manajemenModul.deskripsi: A module is a monitoring and evaluation framework that regulates assessment aspects, evaluated objects, as well as the scope and evaluation indicators within a period. Modules serve as the foundation for M&E implementation to ensure the assessment process runs in a structured, measurable, and consistent manner.

placeholder.cari: Search module by name or description...

create.deskripsi: Form to create a new module with the required information, including name, evaluation scope, and description.

nama.max: Name must be a maximum of 30 characters

deskripsi.max: Description must be a maximum of 255 characters

update.deskripsi: Form to edit existing module information.

deskripsi.max: Description must be a maximum of 255 characters

detail.deskripsiDetail: Use this page to view the details of the evaluation module along with its assessment indicators. The information displayed includes the name, description, and evaluation object.

manajemenLingkup.deskripsi: Use this feature to define the scope of evaluation objects (e.g., Study Programs/Faculties/Units) to be used by the module during object mapping, data retrieval, and reporting. Integration status affects data sources and object availability.

create.deskripsi: Use this feature to create a new evaluation scope as a boundary for objects to be assessed. This scope will be used to structure and track the monitoring process consistently.

detail.deskripsi: Use this page to view evaluation scope details along with connected units and objects. You can expand the scope information, unit list, and evaluation object list for easier data management.

manajemenAspek.deskripsiDetail: Use this page to view the evaluation aspect details.
manajemenAspek.deskripsiBuat: Form to create a new aspect.
manajemenAspek.deskripsiEdit: Use this page to update an evaluation aspect.
